system.description:
Deep Reserves: Gain +1 Stress.

Hardwired: You can have one cybernetic implant without gaining permanent Trauma. You start with Endocrine Synthesizer PEITHO and gain Subtle Pheromones: advantage on rolls to charm or persuade non-hostile creatures.
